records.text: Andrew Kolvet worked in public relations at KAIROS Company under Johnnie Moore, who had been a pastor at Liberty University.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Andrew Kolvet was working PR for the KAIROS Company under Johnnie Moore. Johnnie Moore was the lead pastor at Liberty University prior to then leaving Liberty University to start the PR firm.

verification.notes: KAIROS confirms Moore founded the firm and previously held a senior Liberty role. No independent public source reviewed confirmed Andrew Kolvet’s employment under Moore, and the transcript’s description of Moore as lead pastor is imprecise relative to his documented executive role.

sources.title: KAIROS: Johnnie Moore biography
sources.relevance: Confirms Moore founded KAIROS and previously served as a Liberty University senior vice president.

records.text: Johnnie Moore left Liberty University in 2014 for Hollywood to start the KAIROS Company, where Andrew Kolvet served as an executive vice president.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And you should know that when Johnnie left Liberty University in 2014, he went to Hollywood to start the PR company, the KAIROS Company.

verification.notes: Moore’s bio supports roughly twelve years at Liberty, subsequent recruitment by Mark Burnett in Hollywood, and later founding KAIROS. It does not support the statement’s compressed implication that he left Liberty specifically to start KAIROS, and the consulted primary bio does not establish Andrew Kolvet’s executive-vice-president role.
